note: Catalogue capture uplifted to the held tier-2 Brazilian Army manuals for the VBTP-MR Guarani (EB70-CI-11.412, 2017 and EB70-MT-11.406, 2020). The instruction manual publishes the vehicle weight of 17.5 t and the 600 km range, and the technical manual the 95 km/h maximum road speed. The dimensions and the engine model stay at grade claimed from the tier-5 article because the held manuals publish none. The manuals cover the MR 6x6 configuration; the figures recorded name that variant.
